title: Sermon on the Mount
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child lists the virtues and promises of Matthew 5:7-9 (the merciful will be shown mercy, the pure in heart will see God, the peacemakers will be called children of God) and applies each at home and school.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Matthew 5:39 on not taking revenge.
floor.question: What does Matthew 5:39 teach?
floor.answer: Do not pay back evil with evil

representations: three cards: merciful, pure in heart, peacemakers
steps: Match each blessing to its promise.
contexts: a classmate who wronged you says sorry
being honest when no one checks

board.do: Write three blessings in a column.
Wait for the child to say called children of God.

listen_for: Takes the side of the stronger friend
misconceptions.ask: What does a peacemaker do when two friends quarrel?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what Matthew 5:9 says peacemakers will be called.

listen_for: A clean body and neat clothes
To be weak and let everyone win
misconceptions.ask: What does it mean to be merciful?
misconceptions.repair: Give the example of a prefect who forgives a first mistake.

misconceptions.ask: What does Matthew 5:9 promise the peacemakers?
misconceptions.repair: Match three cards to three promises: merciful, mercy; pure in heart, see God; peacemakers, children of God.

checks.question: What does a peacemaker do when friends quarrel?
checks.answer: Helps them talk and make up

checks.question: What is promised to the pure in heart?
